text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at once, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a prioritized list known as the backlog. These tasks are often written as user stories, which describe what a user needs from the product. Every day, team members hold quick meetings called standups to share progress and discuss problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to adapt to changes, deliver value faster, and continuously improve their work based on feedback.
